Headline: #63 63rd buses Temporary Reroute near 63rd/Michigan
ShortDescription: #63 63rd buses are temporarily rerouted, due to a street blockage near 63rd/Michigan.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

Eastbound #63 63rd buses are temporarily rerouted via 63rd, State, 51st, Prairie, 63rd and then resume their normal route.

Westbound #63 63rd buses are temporarily rerouted via 63rd, Prairie, 59th, State, 63rd and then resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

Buses are rerouted due to a street blockage near 63rd/Michigan.
